snippet.title: Cruise Attack - a long lost BBC Micro Mikro Gen game from 1984!
snippet.description:
A long lost conversion of Mikro Gen's Cruise Attack has just been fully recovered and released for the #BBCMicro. A Missile Command clone that was for reasons unknown never released 40 years ago. Now you can play it for yourself!
https://www.gamesthatwerent.com/2011/07/cruise-attack/
